notes:
Reading comics aloud, properly this time.

The last release taught the app to read tall webtoon strips in slices instead of squinting at the whole thing at once, and the difference was night and day — a caption that used to come out as "Master anting has ohangd tron sword" now reads "Marlin has returned to the goddess' embrace. His fighting spirit will be remembered for eternity", word for word.

This release extends that to the rest of your library and fixes what the first attempt got wrong.

EVERY PAGE, NOT JUST THE TALL ONES. Slicing only kicked in for webtoon strips. Ordinary page scans — most of what is on MangaDex and Weeb Central — were still being read in one gulp, and their lettering was landing below what the text reader can resolve too. It was just less obvious about failing. Now any page big enough to need slicing gets it.

NO MORE HEARING HALF A LINE TWICE. Slices overlap so a speech balloon sitting on a join survives whole. The overlap was too small for a big balloon, so some were cut in every slice and read out twice in pieces. The overlap is bigger, and near-identical pieces are now merged rather than both spoken.

THE END OF LONG CHAPTERS IS NO LONGER DROPPED. Very long strips were quietly cut off partway, so the last stretch was never read.

DIALOGUE IS NO LONGER WHISPERED AS INNER MONOLOGUE. Speech was being treated as thought almost everywhere, because on a webtoon a white speech balloon sits on a white page and the app could not find its outline. It now tells the difference between "this outline is wavy, so it is a thought" and "there is no outline here to judge".
